title: Read an approved LASA document
outcome: Return the exact authorized document content, source identifier, and SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes. The exact text is bounded to 8192 UTF-8 bytes; larger source values fail rather than being silently truncated.
non_guarantees: Does not cover unapproved collections or assert that source-provided content is universally correct.

preconditions.description: Inputs select an approved read-only collection.
Read authority for the approved source is required.

postconditions.criterion: Return the exact authorized document content, source identifier, and SHA-256 of its UTF-8 bytes. The exact text is bounded to 8192 UTF-8 bytes; larger source values fail rather than being silently truncated.
evidence_required: Receiver-generated successful source-operation receipts and digest-verified source artifacts.

failures.meaning: A required approved source is unavailable, denied, or outside the allocation.
